tools.name: query_granola_meetings
tools.title: Query meetings
tools.description: Query Granola about the user's meetings using natural language. Returns a tailored response with inline citation links.

document_ids.description: Optional list of specific meeting IDs to limit context to

query.description: The query to run on Granola meeting notes

tools.name: list_meetings
tools.title: List meetings
tools.description: List the user's Granola meeting notes within a time range. Returns meeting titles, metadata, and note URLs.

tools.name: list_meeting_folders
tools.title: List meeting folders
tools.description: List the user's Granola meeting folders. Returns folder ID, title, description, and note count including nested folders.

tools.name: get_meetings
tools.title: Read meetings
tools.description:
Get detailed meeting information for one or more Granola meetings by ID.
Returns private notes, AI-generated summary, attendees, metadata, and note URLs.

tools.name: get_meeting_transcript
tools.title: Read meeting transcript
tools.description: Get the full transcript for a specific Granola meeting by ID.

tools.name: get_account_info
tools.title: Get account info
tools.description: Get the email, active workspace, and effective note-access scopes for the Granola account currently connected to this MCP session.

tools.name: get_meeting_attachment
tools.title: View meeting attachments
tools.description: Get up to 5 meeting attachments, such as screenshots of shared screens, as images in request order. Provide attachment_ids for a batch or attachment_id for one image. Each image is followed by its metadata; failed attachments return an error with their ID without discarding successful images. Attachment IDs come from the <attachments> section of get_meetings results. Use this when the description alone does not answer the user's question, for example to read a slide, chart, or code on screen.

attachment_id.description: Single attachment ID. Provide exactly one of attachment_id or attachment_ids.

attachment_ids.description: Attachment IDs from the <attachment id="..."> tags in get_meetings results. Provide exactly one of attachment_id or attachment_ids.

meeting_id.description: Meeting UUID or public note ID (not_…). Provide this or note_id.

note_id.description: Alias for meeting_id. Provide exactly one of meeting_id or note_id.
